summary: A synthetic cannabanoid that is a Indazole. Produces subjective effects somewhat similar to that of Cannabis, yet with a very short duration. Analogue of STS-135, in which the core indole structure is subbed with an indazole base.

pharmacology.text: 5F-APINACA acts as a full agonist with a binding affinity of 1.94 nM at CB1 and 0.266 nM at CB2 cannabinoid receptors.

uses.text: 5F-APINACA (also known as A-5F-PINACA, 5F-AKB-48 or 5F-AKB48) is an indazole-based synthetic cannabinoid that has been sold online as a designer drug.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cannabinoids, can cause a racing heart, vomiting, agitation, anxiety, paranoia and confusion. They are far more dangerous than cannabis, with reports of seizures, psychosis, kidney injury, heart attacks and deaths, and regular use can lead to dependence and harsh withdrawal.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的合成大麻素可能引起心跳急促、嘔吐、躁動、焦慮、多疑與意識混亂。它們比大麻危險得多，曾有癲癇發作、精神病、腎損傷、心臟病發作與死亡的報告，長期使用也可能導致成癮與嚴重的戒斷反應。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的合成大麻素可能引起心跳急促、呕吐、躁动、焦虑、多疑与意识混乱。它们比大麻危险得多，曾有癫痫发作、精神病、肾损伤、心脏病发作与死亡的报告，长期使用也可能导致成瘾与严重的戒断反应。

fact.en: Part of its structure is an adamantane cage, a rigid diamond-shaped block of ten carbon atoms whose arrangement is the same as in diamond itself.
fact.zh: 它結構的一部分是金剛烷籠，這是由十個碳原子組成的堅硬鑽石形結構，其排列方式與鑽石本身相同。
fact.zhHans: 它结构的一部分是金刚烷笼，这是由十个碳原子组成的坚硬钻石形结构，其排列方式与钻石本身相同。
